Name: Chonky Bunny
Author: dootcakes
Description:
[left][size=3]Have you ever wanted a chonky bunny of your very own? Well, here you go!
[img]https://i.imgur.com/KP2Wh0d.gif[/img][img]https://i.imgur.com/LzUcr2m.gif[/img][img]https://i.imgur.com/smeBIfi.gif[/img][img]https://i.imgur.com/HZJe9oP.gif[/img][img]https://i.imgur.com/wlP8WDI.gif[/img]﻿﻿

This mod allows you to get a cute bunny as a pet. [b]You can either choose it at the start of the game or adopt it from Marnie[/b]. Gone are the days of replacing the poor orange cat!

Currently, the bunny can give you the following [b]gifts [/b]upon max friendship: wool, clay, wood, dandelion, cabbage, rabbit's foot (don't think too hard about it...)!

Update 1.1: Made compatible with 1.6, Marnie's shop, and content patcher. Chonky Bunny also now has icons for menus/farm creation [i]and[/i] it no longer meows. (Yay!)

Hopefully upcoming: more colors, noises...?

[b]Please Note:[/b]
[/size][list]
[*][size=3]Chonky Bunny is not compatible with hats. I probably won't go back and modify it to be so, either, but we'll see.[/size]
[*][size=3]The adoption scene if Marnie brings the bunny to your farm in Spr Y1 is kind of awkward. It's too much work to change the timing and animations (...idk how).[/size]
[*][size=3][b]I plan to add more colors in the future. [/b]If you're dying to have a particular color, let me know.[/size]
[*][size=3]Any edits of the mod are OK as long as they aren't posted separately. (And please let me know! Maybe I would want to use your mod as well hehe.) However, please try not to use AI in the modification.[/size]
[/list][size=3]
[b]Directions: With SMAPI and Content Patcher installed, download this mod and put it into your Mods folder.
[/b]
To [b]change the price [/b]of the bunny, there are two options:
[/size][list=1]
[*][size=3]Generate a config.json file by running the game through SMAPI after placing [CP] Chonky Bunny in your mods folder. Then, close the game and open the config.json file and edit it.[/size]
[*][size=3]Use Generic Mod Config Menu![/size]
[/list][size=3]
Disclaimer: I'm not actually versed in coding at all, this is all test, trial, and staring at the wiki/game files and other examples of pet mods. Please let me know of any issues. I may not be able to fix them, but I can try! ^-^ [/size][/left]

Downloads.Description: Place in your mods folder with CP and SMAPI installed.
